universe: unique names in the cached one-year universe; one proposal per name/month; no pair beta/correlation cutoff
direction: long-only standalone options, daily stock delta hedging; net long vega is intentional

rules.historical: forecast-based long carry exceeds its previous 24 observed monthly premiums; minimum12 observations
rules.both: absolute and historical conditions both hold

priority: descending same-close long carry; historical-only uses its same-close carry z-score
size: fixed50: half the existing450 dollars per volatility-point entry budget, integer contracts; existing global risk controls and $1m per-name research risk reference
management: hold control, then pooled carry-based fitted Q trained on standalone absolute-rule holdings; no transfer of pair-Q tables
execution: next observed session, existing .1 volatility-point penalty and .03 commission per contract; same financing and stock hedge costs
evaluation: 2018-01-01 through2025-08-29, monthly proposals stopJune2024 to allow runoff
training: quarterly48-month past-prefix fits; cold start holds; training commissions .65; actual PnL per initial vega utility
data_quality: Stop if a held option lacks observed quotes for more than5 trading sessions; retain the trade and restore verified vendor identity/history before replaying

resources.warning_mode: At most384 MiB, critical pressure always stops

storage: stream cached quote batches into a disk-backed indexed SQLite store; bounded day caches and streamed holding observations; exact float64 read-only mapped stock/EWMA caches; replay loads frozen settings without old training modules
